blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Удостоверьтесь, что устройство прочно прикреплено к ___ (потолок).
exercises.prompt: Make sure that the device is attached firmly to the ceiling.
exercises.why: The preposition к (to, towards, in the direction of) always requires the dative case and is widely used with verbs of motion. — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book. Lesson 29. From the Wikibooks Russian textbook (CC BY-SA 4.0).  ·  «The preposition к (to, towards, in the direction of …) always requires the dative case … The preposition по means "along" and is used with the dative case.» — DLI, Lessons 28–29.
exercises.context: The preposition к (to, towards, in the direction of) always requires the dative case and is widely used with verbs of motion.

exercises.q: Кристиан, иди к ___ (доска) и решай задачу.
exercises.prompt: Christian, come to the blackboard and solve the problem.
exercises.why: After a verb of motion, к followed by a noun denoting a person indicates going to see that person at his place: *Я иду к полковнику.* Followed by a noun denoting an object or a place, it indicates motion toward that object or place: *Студент идёт к доске. Самолёты летят к морю.* — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book. Lesson 29.
